command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = '/workspace/project/NOTES.md'
with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.read().split('\n')
assert lines[2].startswith('Tagline:'), lines[2]
# literal backslash-escaped unicode to avoid tool-layer normalization
lines[2] = 'Tagline: \u201cFast\u201d and \u2018simple\u2019'
with open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write('\n'.join(lines))
EOF
python3 -c "
for line in open('/workspace/project/NOTES.md', encoding='utf-8'):
    print(repr(line), [hex(ord(c)) for c in line if not c.isascii()])
"
